description: This file defines a class MacroTokenParser used for parsing macro definitions in Twig templates, including methods for parsing macro arguments, deciding macro block end, and managing scope.

classes.name: MacroTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing macro definitions in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a macro token, creates a MacroNode, and registers it in the parser.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token marks the end of a macro block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'macro' associated with this token parser.

methods.name: parseDefinition
methods.description: Parses macro argument definitions, including default values.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Checks if a node contains only constant expressions, unary operations, or array expressions.
